livetv.tab.description: Live TV: the top tab strip's pill that opens the channel guide

livetv.setup.body.value: Watch the channels on your Tunarr server. PlxNative can look for it on this network, or you can type its address.
livetv.setup.body.description: Live TV setup page: explanation under the title. Tunarr is a product name; keep it.

livetv.setup.search.description: Live TV setup: button that searches the local network for a Tunarr server

livetv.setup.searching.description: Live TV setup: the search button while the network search runs

livetv.setup.none_found.value: No Tunarr server answered on this network.
livetv.setup.none_found.description: Live TV setup: shown after a network search found nothing

livetv.setup.address.description: Live TV setup: button that opens the on-screen keyboard to type the Tunarr server address

livetv.setup.address_hint.value: Type Tunarr's IP address. Without a port, :8000 is used
livetv.setup.address_hint.description: Live TV setup: placeholder text in the address field while it is empty

livetv.setup.retry.description: Live TV setup: retry loading the configured server

livetv.setup.turn_off.description: Live TV setup: forget the configured server and hide Live TV

livetv.setup.back.description: Live TV setup: return to the channel guide without changing the server

livetv.setup.failed.description: Live TV setup: the configured server could not be loaded. {server} is its address.

livetv.loading.description: Live TV: shown while the channel guide loads

livetv.empty.value: This Tunarr server has no channels yet.
livetv.empty.description: Live TV: the server answered but lists no channels

livetv.no_info.description: Live TV guide: a channel time slot with no listing

livetv.guide_missing.value: The guide isn’t available. Channels still play.
livetv.guide_missing.description: Live TV guide: the channel list loaded but the program guide did not

livetv.change_server.description: Live TV guide: button that opens the setup page to pick another Tunarr server

livetv.live.description: Live TV player: the badge marking a live channel. A short mark, all caps.

livetv.tuning.description: Live TV player: shown while a channel starts

livetv.unavailable.value: This channel isn’t available right now. Press OK to try again.
livetv.unavailable.description: Live TV player: a channel could not be started

livetv.next.description: Live TV player: the program after the current one. {title} is its name.

settings.livetv.section.description: Settings: section heading for Live TV

settings.livetv.title.description: Settings: row that opens Live TV setup

settings.livetv.detail.description: Settings: description under the Live TV row. Tunarr is a product name.

settings.livetv.off.description: Settings: the Live TV row's value while no Tunarr server is set up

livetv.starts_in.description: Live TV guide: an upcoming program that starts within the hour. {time} is a duration such as “25 min” or “1 hr 5 min”.

livetv.filter.all.description: Live TV guide: genre filter chip that shows every channel

livetv.filter.movies.description: Live TV guide: genre filter chip for films

livetv.filter.sports.description: Live TV guide: genre filter chip for sport

livetv.filter.kids.description: Live TV guide: genre filter chip for children's programs and animation

livetv.filter.news.description: Live TV guide: genre filter chip for news

livetv.filter.documentary.description: Live TV guide: genre filter chip for documentaries

livetv.filter.comedy.description: Live TV guide: genre filter chip for comedy and sitcoms

livetv.filter.empty.value: Nothing in {filter} for these two hours.
livetv.filter.empty.description: Live TV guide: the chosen genre filter matches no program in the visible two hours. {filter} is the chip's name (Movies, Sports, or a category from the guide).

livetv.plex_hint.value: Hold {key} to watch from the start in Plex
livetv.plex_hint.description: Live TV guide: complete sentence shown when the focused program is in the viewer's Plex library; holding OK opens it there. {key} is the OK button rendered as a keycap; keep exactly one occurrence. Plex is a product name.

livetv.studio.title.description: Live TV channel studio: page title, and the guide's pill that opens it. Channels are built from the viewer's own Plex library.

livetv.studio.suggested.description: Live TV channel studio: heading of the row of suggested channels

livetv.studio.yours.description: Live TV channel studio: heading of the row of channels the viewer kept

livetv.studio.keep.description: Live TV channel studio: button that adds the previewed channel to the guide

livetv.studio.keeping.description: Live TV channel studio: the Keep button while the channel is being saved

livetv.studio.reshuffle.description: Live TV channel studio: button that shuffles the channel's schedule again

livetv.studio.order.description: Live TV channel studio: button that cycles how programmes are ordered. {style} is one of the order style names.

livetv.studio.style.random.description: Live TV channel order style: programmes in random order

livetv.studio.style.rotation.description: Live TV channel order style: one show after another in turn

livetv.studio.style.blocks.description: Live TV channel order style: a few episodes of one show back to back

livetv.studio.style.order.description: Live TV channel order style: episodes in their broadcast order

livetv.studio.not_interested.description: Live TV channel studio: button that hides this suggestion for good

livetv.studio.watch.description: Live TV channel studio: button that tunes a kept channel

livetv.studio.delete.description: Live TV channel studio: button that deletes a kept channel

livetv.studio.delete_confirm.description: Live TV channel studio: the Delete button after one press, asking for a second

livetv.studio.surprise.description: Live TV channel studio: card and button that draw a surprise channel from the library

livetv.studio.surprise_again.description: Live TV channel studio: button that draws a different surprise channel

livetv.studio.surprise_body.value: A channel from a corner of your library you might not think of. Press OK to draw one.
livetv.studio.surprise_body.description: Live TV channel studio: explanation shown on the Surprise Me card before a channel is drawn

livetv.studio.on_now.description: Live TV channel studio preview: label before the programme airing now

livetv.studio.up_next.description: Live TV channel studio preview: label before the programmes airing next

livetv.studio.building.description: Live TV channel studio: shown while the channel's schedule is worked out

livetv.studio.unbuildable.value: Nothing in your library fits this channel right now.
livetv.studio.unbuildable.description: Live TV channel studio: the channel's rules match no titles

livetv.studio.kept.description: Live TV channel studio: confirmation after a channel was kept. {number} is its channel number.

livetv.studio.failed.value: Couldn’t save the channel to Plex.
livetv.studio.failed.description: Live TV channel studio: the channel could not be written to the Plex server. Plex is a product name.

livetv.studio.loading.description: Live TV channel studio: shown while the Plex library is read to suggest channels

livetv.studio.empty.value: Channels appear here once your Plex library has been read.
livetv.studio.empty.description: Live TV channel studio: nothing to suggest yet. Plex is a product name.

livetv.studio.number.description: Live TV channel studio: a kept channel's number. {number} is the number.

livetv.behind.description: Live TV banner: badge shown in place of LIVE when a virtual channel is paused behind live. Short, capitals like LIVE.

livetv.jump_to_live.description: Live TV banner: hint beside the channel name when a virtual channel is behind live; OK is the remote's button

livetv.studio.edit.description: Live TV channel studio: button that opens the options for a suggested channel

livetv.studio.done.description: Live TV channel studio: closes the channel options

livetv.studio.kinds_both.description: Live TV channel option: the channel airs films and TV episodes

livetv.studio.kinds_movies.description: Live TV channel option: the channel airs films only

livetv.studio.kinds_episodes.description: Live TV channel option: the channel airs TV episodes only

livetv.studio.unwatched.description: Live TV channel option, on or off: only titles the viewer has not watched

livetv.studio.rating_any.description: Live TV channel option: no content rating limit

livetv.studio.rating_up_to.description: Live TV channel option: the highest content rating allowed. {rating} is a rating such as PG-13.

livetv.studio.hours.description: Live TV channel studio: how many hours of programmes a channel holds
